text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preselects the sharpest regions to upscale, giving a measurable quality bump without extra compute—exactly the 0.5% lift we need. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in batch processing, but the depth map keeps the upscaler focused where it matters most.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it only sharpens existing detail, not regenerate lost facial features. The real risk is wasting 0.5% effort on a tool that doesn’t address the core failure mode. Test RealVisXL v1.1’s face model instead; if it delivers >0.5% gain on benchmark faces, adopt it—else default to SDXL-Lightning for faster, cleaner upscaling.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add RealVisXL v1.1’s face model to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates lost facial features instead of just sharpening blurry ones, directly fixing the core failure mode Torque flagged. The trade-off is higher VRAM usage and slower inference, but the face fidelity gain outweighs the cost—this is the only tool in the stack that actively reconstructs missing detail.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL v1.1’s face model risks overfitting to synthetic faces—EXCAVA’s real-world footage may degrade if the model hallucinates features that don’t exist. Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler *only* on faces first; if it recovers lost fidelity without regeneration artifacts, it’s the safer 0.5% lift. Settle it with a blind A/B test: 50 real face crops, no labels, measure PSNR/SSIM against ground truth.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Run InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler on face crops first—if it recovers lost fidelity without artifacts, adopt it; if not, switch to RealVisXL v1.1’s face model for regeneration. Result must deliver measurable face fidelity gain or clear rejection within 48 hours. Torque owns the test and verdict.
